text: one structure with three straight walls and then one curved wall,
one wall that made a shape like a semicircle.
But it was all one building.
So they realized that they're not going to be able to do that, so they made, instead, they made a cube
with three of the walls on the same area,
but then they cut off the last wall that was a, that was a circular wall, and they actually closed it off and made it into a straight wall.
And the area that originally was encompassed by the curved wall, they put a, they put like an arch, like a semicircle there,
so that you know that this originally was part of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. This was actually the fourth wall of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] around here.
So they demarcated that place to make sure that it was known that this was the original structure, and it is still like that today.
When you go to the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] today, you see that the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] is a square structure, but on one side, you see that semicircle,
and that is called [[Hijr Ismail|حجر إسماعيل]].
And that is actually, originally, that was part of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. The whole building, the structure of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], actually encompassed that whole area.
But because they didn't have the funds to complete that, the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] is as you see it today,
and they kept that area there to demarcate it so that the people know that this originally, actually, this is part of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] as well.
So that's why it's very important, if you go for [[Umrah|عمرة]] or if you go for [[Hajj|حج]] or if you want to do [[tawaf|طواف]],
you have to make sure that you go around that semicircle. Don't make the mistake and circumambulate only around the cube.
Don't try to cut in to that area between the semicircle and the cube. Don't try to cut into that area and make [[tawaf|طواف]] only around the cube. If you do that, your [[tawaf|طواف]] is not valid,
because that is not the original structure, the original surface area of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. You have to go completely around the semicircle as well.
So that was one of the changes in the construction they had to make because of lack of funds. Another change that they made
is regarding the door of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. If you go to the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] today,
you will see that it has one door. Those days, it used to have two doors.
One door on the side where you see it today and one door on the opposite side.
One door where you see it today and one door was on the opposite side as well. And the people used to go in through one door and go out through the other door.
This was the common practice of the people: go in through the door that we have today, and go out through the door that was on the opposite side.
So they said, "Okay, we're not going to make the second door. We'll just make the first door."
And another thing that they decided to do is to elevate that door.
In those days, the door of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was on the ground level. But they decided, "No, we're not going to make it on the ground level. We're going to elevate it. We're going to make it up."
And the reason why they decided to do this was so that they could control who goes in the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].

They didn't want just anyone going inside the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. They said, "We're going to control who goes in the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] and who doesn't get to go in the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], so we're going to elevate that door."

So these were some of the changes that they made: one door, elevated the door, and the surface area of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was shortened, and it was made into a cube shape instead of three sides straight and one side semicircle.

And the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]], he had seen the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] how it was before, because this happened when he was 35 years old. So he knows how the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was before that as well.

So he said, later on when he became powerful and after the conquest of [[Makkah|مكّة]], when the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] had control of [[Makkah|مكّة]], he could have ordered for it to be rebuilt as it was before,
but he said to [[Aishah|عائشة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], he said, "If it weren't for the fact that your people are new to Islam,"

many of those people of the [[Quraysh|قريش]], they just accepted Islam after the conquest of [[Makkah|مكّة]], after the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] came into [[Makkah|مكّة]] victorious,

and the conquest of [[Makkah|مكّة]] was complete. Many of those people of [[Makkah|مكّة]] who were not Muslims before, they were the staunchest enemies of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] before, they became Muslim after that conquest of [[Makkah|مكّة]].
And they were new Muslims. And the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] wanted the [[Iman|إيمان]] to become stronger in their hearts.

So he said to [[Aishah|عائشة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], "If it wasn't for the fact that your people," meaning the [[Quraysh|قريش]], "if it wasn't for the fact that they are new to Islam, I would have rebuilt the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] again as it was"
on the foundations of [[Ibrahim|إبراهيم]] [[alayhis-salam|عليه السلام]], the way that it was before.
But he decided not to do that, and this shows the [[hikmah|حكمة]] of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]], the wisdom. He decided not to do that because he thought

that it would cause [[fitnah|فتنة]] with the people. The Arabs, they're used to the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] the way that it is now. If we change it, even though we're changing it actually back to the original form, if we change it, they may think that, "Oh, what is this? He changed the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]." And they're new Muslims.
So he saw from his wisdom that it was better not to do this. And this again shows the intelligence and the wisdom of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]].
It also happened later on in history, during the time of [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]],

when [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]] was fighting [[al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf|الحجاج بن يوسف]], and [[al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf|الحجاج بن يوسف]] was striking at [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]] in [[Makkah|مكّة]] with catapults.

During that time, [[al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf|الحجاج بن يوسف]], he damaged the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] with his attacks on [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]]. The [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was hit in the crossfire and the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was damaged.
So [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]], he rebuilt the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] as it originally was.
He rebuilt it with the semicircle portion included in the building, and he made two doors, and he made the door low instead of keeping it elevated.
So basically, he rebuilt it to the way that it was before the [[Quraysh|قريش]] rebuilt it. He rebuilt it in that way. So it was restored to its original way at one point in history.
And then, when [[al-Hajjaj|الحجاج]] got the upper hand and he got control of [[Makkah|مكّة]], he said, "Look what [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]] did."
"He played around with the house of Allah, and he messed up the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]." And [[al-Hajjaj|الحجاج]] ordered for it to be made back to the way it was, the way the [[Quraysh|قريش]] made it.
So it went back to that form again, the form that it is in today. [[al-Hajjaj|الحجاج]] did that.
Then, when the [[khalifah|خليفة]] of the Muslims, [[Abdul Malik ibn Marwan|عبد الملك بن مروان]], when he heard about this,
he said, "No, no. What [[al-Hajjaj|الحجاج]] did was wrong and what [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]] did was right." So he said, "I'm going to make it back to that way again."
And then [[Imam Malik|إمام مالك]] [[rahimahullah|رَحِمَهُ اللهُ]], the great Imam, [[Imam Malik ibn Anas|إمام مالك بن أنس]],
he told [[Abdul Malik ibn Marwan|عبد الملك بن مروان]], he told the leader, he said, "Please, don't do it. Leave it. Leave it how it is."

And then [[Abdul Malik|عبد الملك]] asked [[Imam Malik|إمام مالك]], he said, "But isn't the way that [[Abdullah ibn Zubayr|عَبْد الله بن الزُّبَيْر]] how he rebuilt it, isn't that how it originally was? Isn't that the right way?" And [[Imam Malik|إمام مالك]] said, "Yes, that is the right way."
"But we cannot make the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] like a toy in the hands of the rulers. This ruler decides to do this, and then this ruler decides to do that, and then this ruler decides to do that."

"We cannot make the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] a toy in the hands of the rulers. Just leave it how it is and don't touch it." This was the [[hikmah|حكمة]] of [[Imam Malik|إمام مالك]] [[rahimahullah|رَحِمَهُ اللهُ]].
So [[Abdul Malik ibn Marwan|عبد الملك بن مروان]], he listened to this advice and he left it as it is, and it is still that way today.
The Saudi government, if they want to, they have enough money to rebuild it as it was before, they could do it. But they don't do it because of this reason,

because the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] cannot be like a toy with every ruler doing what he wants with it. So this is the way it is, and this is the way that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] has decreed for it to be.
So this is the history of the rebuilding of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].
So once they finished the rebuilding, once they finished that rebuilding, there was one last step that needed to be made,
and that was placing [[al-Hajar al-Aswad|الحجر الأسود]], placing the black stone back into its corner, back into its place.
This is a great honor. Who's going to do this? We have many subtribes of the [[Quraysh|قريش]]:
[[Banu Abd al-Dar|بنو عبد الدار]], [[Banu Makhzum|بنو مخزوم]], so many different tribes, each one wants to have this honor for themselves.
So they start fighting over it, like who's going to get this honor, who's going to do it.

And it reached to such an extent where [[Banu Abd al-Dar|بنو عبد الدار]], they took a jug of blood, and each one of them put their hands into the blood. Each member of that tribe, they put their hands in that blood,
and they said, "We swear, we swear that we are going to be the ones who put that stone in its place."

And when [[Banu Makhzum|بنو مخزوم]] saw what [[Banu Abd al-Dar|بنو عبد الدار]] were doing, they said, "Okay, we can do that too." They got their own vessel of blood, and they put their hands in the blood, and they said, "We swear it will be someone from us, from our tribe, who is going to put that stone where it is."
So this is how much they regarded that being a great honor for them to put that stone in its place. So the [[fitnah|فتنة]] became very intense, and they were ready to fight about it.
And then one wise old man, and his name was [[Abu Umayyah ibn al-Mughirah|أبو أمية بن المغيرة]], he said, "Look..."
